text: One phone, in a dark room.
It rang in pockets in every city on earth.
One in three phones sold in the world carried this name.
Then the phone stopped being a phone. It became a computer.
Nokia answered late, and then it stopped.
It began in 1865, with a paper mill in a small Finnish town.
Paper, rubber, cables, electronics. One company, four industries.
By 2007 it was the largest phone maker on earth. Then the ground moved.
